title: Harden GMGN wallet stats parser schema contract, period verification, unit rate, and zero semantics
objective: Harden GMGN wallet stats parser (v2) to eliminate broad recursive alias scanning, depth scoring, cross-node field composition, and unverified period/completeness assumptions. Introduce explicit schema contracts, expectedPeriod verification, completeness by field coverage, strict non-numeric/null/zero semantics, fail-closed winRate units, and safe allowlisted warning codes.
forbidden_actions: Do not issue any live network or provider requests; budget must be strictly zero.
Do not call GMGN CLI, Helius, Chain.fm, Dune, Dexscreener, Birdeye, or RPC.
Do not read, display, or forward credentials, GMGN_API_KEY, GMGN_PRIVATE_KEY, proxy URLs, or plaintext address files (sol_addresses.txt, sol_address_labels.json).
Do not modify node_modules or include node_modules in task inputs or Git.
Do not perform arbitrary recursive alias scanning or depth scoring in parser.
Do not force completeness=1 on arbitrary MAPPED status in consumers.
Do not write outside the exact tracked write set.
